meta.note: Generated skeleton. ownerArea, verdict, and lane are absent until P2 assigns them.

findings.title: Crafted review counts can crash Yeet closeout and monitoring

validation.rationale: Security Cloud validation and attack-path analysis identify a public PR review body whose oversized Greptile count reaches S.Finite through the Yeet parser. Current HEAD still parsed decimal captures without a safe-integer bound or saturated aggregate; the focused regression reproduces the input and passes after repair.

remediation.summary: Saturate untrusted review counts and aggregates at a finite ceiling before checked schema construction; retain advisory visibility.

findings.title: Credential-bank regex enables small-input denial of service

validation.rationale: Security Cloud evidence identifies backtracking in the canonical secret-assignment regex on a 4 KiB key-like token. The source at current HEAD retained the ambiguous regex prefix, and the focused regression covers detection, counting, and replacement plus a nested true match.

remediation.summary: Scan candidate assignment keys with a linear token grammar, then classify captured keys against credential keywords before producing matches.

findings.title: Draft edits can bypass the outbox send expectation guard

validation.rationale: The code checked a mutable Graph draft and then sent only by id in a separate operation, without a documented version precondition.

remediation.summary: Fail closed with version-unbound after the expectation check; no Graph send action is called. Document manual Outlook send and the path to restoring a bound operation.

findings.title: Crafted attachment names persistently block mail tagging

validation.rationale: Security Cloud established a three-message deterministic filename collision against the create-only DocumentStore contract. The current filer exhausted two candidate names and failed before tagging or checkpointing; the existing test demonstrated repeatable failure.

remediation.summary: Record exhausted names as durable abandonments plus a named attachment skip, so the poison message cannot block later mail.

findings.title: Boundary-date emails can crash the docket intake service

validation.rationale: The current Graph adapter still passed the accepted maximum LocalDate into all-day window construction, where exclusive-end arithmetic exceeds the supported year range and throws outside typed error handling. Live model extraction remains untested.

remediation.summary: Reject an unrepresentable all-day exclusive end as a typed calendar error before sending a Graph request.

findings.title: Review checkpoints expose mail content through permissive files

validation.rationale: Security Cloud traced source-bearing review rounds into the live file store. Current HEAD still created the state directory and atomic replacement without explicit private modes; exposure depends on traversable ancestors and a permissive umask.

remediation.summary: Enforce owner-only state and digest directories and atomic file modes, including pre-existing state-directory permissions.

findings.title: Mail-tagging state can be readable by other local users

validation.rationale: Security Cloud traced the CLI lock and state-file adapter to plaintext metadata files created without explicit modes. Current HEAD retained that behavior; exposure depends on traversable ancestors and a permissive umask.

remediation.summary: Enforce owner-only state-directory and ledger modes for attended commands and the sample user service.

findings.title: Job-log ANSI filter can reconstruct terminal control sequences

validation.rationale: The current sanitizer removed ANSI sequences once, allowing nested OSC and CSI bytes to join into terminal controls. A stubbed job-log regression reproduces the reconstruction; live terminal clipboard mutation was not established.

remediation.summary: Remove residual C0/C1 terminal controls after ANSI substitution so reconstructed escape sequences are inert.

findings.title: Tesseract file-list input bypasses the corpus read boundary

validation.rationale: The current corpus OCR path selected images by extension and passed unvalidated bytes to Tesseract after the source-path guard. The report traced the input to the native image-or-file-list argument, while noting its native execution proof gap.

verificationCommands: bunx vitest run test/corpus-command.test.ts --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 -t 'reads scans and images|rejects image-named|reads a single-frame TIFF'
remediation.summary: Decode and re-encode bounded raster input as PNG before it reaches Tesseract; skip malformed images.

findings.title: Mail attachment names inject terminal controls during intake

validation.rationale: The current Graph attachment schema permits control characters and skipped/duplicate row names reached the terminal formatter without escaping. The report demonstrated the exact formatter in isolation; live Graph name preservation was not tested.

verificationCommands: bunx vitest run test/drawings-intake.test.ts --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 -t 'saves the newest reviewer|pulls through the lane'
remediation.summary: Replace control and format characters in printed attachment and duplicate names while preserving raw names in JSON provenance.

findings.title: Source checkout preloads can forge signed pilot evidence

validation.rationale: The current supervisor ran Bun with the separate source checkout as cwd and no trusted config, allowing its preload to run before the worker. Security Cloud reproduced the startup primitive and traced forgeable receipt fields; full envelope issuance was not executed.

remediation.summary: Pass an empty supervisor-owned Bun configuration with the exact --config=<path> form.

findings.title: Hook resolver executes code from an untrusted current checkout

validation.rationale: Twenty-one current hook commands selected executable code from the current Git checkout based only on .claude/hooks directory presence.

remediation.summary: Anchor hook executable paths to CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR and skip if absent; a crafted-checkout regression exercises the configured shell and Node commands.

findings.title: Aliased packages bypass the exact-version Bun audit ignore guard

validation.rationale: The current selector matched lock entries only by key, omitting alias keys whose tuple resolves to the reviewed package at another version. The report reproduced this guard gap offline; the current lockfile has no such alias.

verificationCommands: bunx vitest run test/quality-tasks.test.ts --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 -t 'mirrors exact package overrides only'
remediation.summary: Include resolved tuple identity when checking every version of a package before mirroring an advisory-wide Bun ignore.

findings.title: Backdated commits bypass the new merge review window

validation.rationale: The current REST merge gate used attacker-controlled committer metadata as the head review-window time. The report reproduced backdating at a local receiver and the affected gate path remains live.

remediation.summary: Anchor the REST review window to GitHub check-suite receipt and force-push timeline evidence; fail closed when receipt evidence is unavailable.

findings.title: Address substring parsing bypasses attachment sender restrictions

validation.rationale: The current helper extracted an arbitrary angle-bracket substring before validating the sender address. A quoted local part can contain that substring while its actual domain differs; Microsoft 365 preservation remains unverified.

verificationCommands: bunx vitest run test/MailTagging.mailbox.test.ts --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 -t 'reads quoted and Name|does not treat an angle-bracket'
remediation.summary: Anchor header-form parsing to the complete trimmed provider value; reject bracket fragments inside a different address.

findings.title: Publisher PDF discovery bypasses internal-source restrictions
Correspondent parser allows CPU-exhausting regex backtracking

validation.rationale: The unanchored display-name regexp overlapped whitespace quantifiers and was observed taking seconds on a few thousand spaces before lookup input validation. The path is used by lookup and imported email metadata.

verificationCommands: bunx vitest run test/PracticeKg.correspondents.test.ts --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 -t 'reads one address from a bare address'
remediation.summary: Split entries in a linear scan, use anchored address patterns, and reject oversized headers before parsing.

findings.title: Backslash filenames escape scorer staging and enable code execution

validation.rationale: The current snapshot normalizer converted literal POSIX backslashes to separators, and the law-lane copy joined the resulting relative path without containment checks. The report reproduced path transformation; complete scorer execution was not tested there.

verificationCommands: bunx vitest run test/agent-effectiveness-eval-scorer.test.ts --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 -t 'refuses a backslash-normalized traversal'
remediation.summary: Resolve both source and staging copy paths under their canonical roots before copying any fixture file.

findings.title: Repository-controlled ignore globs can hang Graft via ReDoS

validation.rationale: The current 0.21.1 deep-ignore dist patch still compiled untrusted glob rules to overlapping regex repetitions. The same sink remained after the report's older version.

remediation.summary: Use memoized glob matching instead of a backtracking regular expression.

findings.title: Adoption writes outside the packet through directory symlinks

validation.rationale: A packet ops symlink to an external writable directory would be followed by recursive parent creation and exclusive file creation. The final wx flag prevented overwrite but not external creation.

remediation.summary: Route exclusive creation through the shared symlink-free contained filesystem guard. The helper creates missing parents component by component, rejects links and escapes, rechecks containment, and retains wx.

findings.title: Predictable codemod staging paths allow symlink file overwrite
Quadratic overlap enumeration enables drawing-spec denial of service

validation.rationale: The prior A.flatMap allocated all unordered part pairs before filtering and ModelSpec had no maximum part count.

remediation.summary: Count overlaps incrementally and reject models above 256 parts at schema decoding; boundary regression passes.

findings.ownerArea: OCCT overlap counting and model schema

findings.title: Intake inspector can leak document bytes to the hosted relay
New line-value locator permits repository-triggered ReDoS

validation.rationale: Current HEAD used a global before(.*?)after regex for every selected line. The seeded JudgePack locator selects empty-prefix lines, and an adversarial repeated-opening line exercised the slow path.

remediation.summary: Scan each line once with literal delimiter searches and advance past each completed match. The focused repeated-opening regression and all locator tests pass.

findings.title: Artifact upload allows command execution through zip filenames

validation.rationale: The current POSIX zip command places -- before every file operand. Commit 58766950c5 added the terminator after the reported source commit, and a focused scratchpad test covers leading-dash filenames.

verificationCommands: bunx vitest run --config scratchpad/vitest.config.ts scratchpad/test/github-actions/archiveCommands.test.ts --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 -t 'leading-dash paths follow'
remediation.summary: The current command already terminates Info-ZIP option parsing before attacker-influenced relative filenames.

findings.title: Event deletion permits traversal to other Graph resources

validation.rationale: The current public deleteEvent method interpolates a GraphPathSegment into DELETE. The old schema accepted tab/backslash traversal that WHATWG URL normalizes to a different Graph resource.

verificationCommands: bunx vitest run test/M365.write.test.ts --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 -t 'rejects URL-normalized traversal'
remediation.summary: Reject URL delimiters and ASCII controls in Graph path identifiers.

findings.title: Bootstrap executes unverified op during status logging

validation.rationale: The current bootstrap script executed op from PATH unconditionally, including after a verification failure. This could run an unverified executable inherited from a reused environment.

remediation.summary: Record the absolute destination only after a verified install and query that exact path for status. Report missing without invoking any PATH op when verification or installation did not succeed.

findings.title: Staging cleanup can delete data through a symlinked goals root

validation.rationale: The current sweep followed the goals root when enumerating .staging-* names. The review plan did not bind that directory identity.

remediation.summary: Reject a symlinked goals root before reading or deleting staging entries. A regression preserves an external .staging-* tree.

findings.title: Model report symlinks can overwrite operator files

validation.rationale: The current command wrote both reports with ordinary writeFileString after creating the directory. Existing final-component symlinks were followed even when the model check later reported drift.

verificationCommands: bunx vitest run test/models-init-command.test.ts --pool=forks --maxWorkers=1 -t 'does not overwrite a file through a symlinked report name'
remediation.summary: Use the shared contained atomic writer for each report. It rejects symlink destinations and symlinked path entries and never truncates a linked target.

findings.title: Quadratic regex permits denial of service in OA recognition

validation.rationale: The current recognizer passed document-controlled text to an unanchored regex whose lazy suffix search restarted at each marker. Repeated incomplete markers forced quadratic work.

verificationCommands: bunx vitest run test/DocStructure.test.ts --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 -t 'handles repeated incomplete statutory-period markers'
remediation.summary: Split text once at period boundaries and check each disjoint segment with direct substring searches. The regression covers a long repeated-marker input and the supported ELEVEN terminator.

findings.title: Undo can delete calendar entries verified after planning
Boundary-date input can repeatedly abort docket intake polls

validation.rationale: The current reminder ladder subtracted every offset before filtering past results. A valid year-one deadline underflows LocalDate during that subtraction, and the focused boundary test exercises the policy.

remediation.summary: Filter reminder offsets by distance to the due date before subtracting from a potentially boundary-year date.

findings.title: New Bash grants bypass the Beep-only log access restriction

validation.rationale: The current checked-in settings and ai-sync allow domain contained both raw prefix grants. Repeated journalctl -u selectors combine as an OR filter, so the Beep prefix did not confine later arguments.

verificationCommands: bunx vitest run test/ai-sync.test.ts --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 -t 'keeps checked-in Claude grants'
remediation.summary: Remove the two unsafe automatic grants from checked-in settings and the exact ai-sync allow domain. The read-only list-timers grant remains. A constrained wrapper can be added separately if log access is needed.

findings.title: Crafted PDF font graphs cause exponential validation work

validation.rationale: The current inspector recursively revisited the same PDFDict for each repeated DescendantFonts edge and had no cycle or traversal limit. The attack can be reached by a crafted PDF submitted for drawing validation.

remediation.summary: Memoize embedded results by PDF dictionary identity, reject cycles, and cap distinct node visits and depth. A generated PDF regression uses a deep shared graph; another checks a cycle.

findings.title: Historical citations cause unbounded repository archive copies

validation.rationale: Current HEAD accepts every unique commit marker in one report and calls the historical tree materializer for each. A focused test exercises five distinct historical markers.

verificationCommands: bunx vitest run test/knowledge-doctor.test.ts --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 -t 'rejects more than four historical commits'
remediation.summary: Reject a report with more than four distinct historical commits before ancestry resolution and delete each compressed archive immediately after extraction. The limit is per report and can be revisited with a bounded streaming design.

findings.title: Unsafe shell quoting in PR-title recovery commands

validation.rationale: The current publish path used argument arrays for its own GitHub requests, but both recovery messages interpolated the title into shell text. A failure during PR rename made that text visible to an operator.

verificationCommands: bunx vitest run test/yeet-scripted-process.test.ts --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 -t 'reports a refused rename without failing the publish'
remediation.summary: Replace both runnable recovery commands with a GitHub title-edit instruction that includes no untrusted title bytes. A regression uses a command-substitution title and asserts it is absent from the failure message.

findings.title: Checkout-root swaps bypass residue-reap containment

validation.rationale: Current HEAD obtains the outer boundary during application from a mutable checkout path. The regression replaces the path with a symlink after the first probe and confirms the replacement is refused.

verificationCommands: bunx vitest run test/residue-reap.test.ts --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 -t 'refuses a checkout root swap'
remediation.summary: Resolve and freeze each checkout root boundary in settings before discovery; use only the frozen boundary for candidate application.

findings.title: Font metadata can inject executable generated TypeScript

validation.rationale: Current HEAD interpolated a parsed font version into the source comment without escaping. Custom font paths are supported by the generator.

remediation.summary: Emit only SHA-256 digests in the generated provenance comment and remove the unnecessary version parser. Regenerate the committed glyph module from the default fonts.

findings.title: Corpus resume follows output symlinks outside its root
Cursor shell deny guard can be bypassed with pathname globs

validation.rationale: The current hook rejected dollar expansion but accepted bracket, star, and question-mark globs. A local hook fixture confirmed that the globbed Git command received allow before the fix.

verificationCommands: Python JSON-payload fixture for the configured shell hook: globbed Git denied, plain echo allowed, literal Git denied
remediation.summary: Reject commands containing pathname glob syntax in the guard and document the conservative literal-command policy. A hook fixture now denies the globbed Git spelling and still permits a plain command.

findings.title: Unnormalized sensitivity labels bypass memory access checks
Departed terminal shells bypass retirement write detection
Size-only Box conflicts can falsely complete pending filings

validation.rationale: The current use case adopted a conflict by equal size when SHA-1 metadata was absent. The production adapter can forward size independently from hash, making the conditional path reachable.

verificationCommands: bunx vitest run test/MailTagging.filer.test.ts --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 -t 'store reports a size and no hash'
remediation.summary: Require a matching content hash to adopt an existing file; otherwise retire the pending intent and upload under the short-hash alternate name. The size-only regression now expects that fallback.

findings.title: Unvalidated Fallow sidecars can block the tmpfs janitor

validation.rationale: The current discovery path read every matching .last-used sidecar before age and process checks. A FIFO without a writer could wait indefinitely.

verificationCommands: bunx vitest run test/tmpfs-reap.test.ts --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 -t 'ignores FIFO, symlink, and oversized Fallow owner sidecars'
remediation.summary: Open sidecars without following the final symlink and with nonblocking flags, accept only regular files, and cap reads at 4096 bytes. A focused test covers FIFO, symlink, and oversized inputs.

findings.title: Chunked uploads commit swapped sources before checking integrity
Review round writes follow symlinks outside the corpus root

validation.rationale: Current HEAD used ordinary writeFile on each round output after validating only the matter directory. The focused tests exercise a linked review directory and a linked inventory leaf.

verificationCommands: bunx vitest run test/drawings-review.test.ts --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 -t 'replaces a linked inventory entry|refuses a symlinked review directory'
remediation.summary: Create review directories through no-follow directory descriptors, verify the bound directory remains under the corpus root, and atomically replace each round file through its bound parent. A symlink leaf is replaced without writing its target.

findings.title: Provenance outputs follow symlinks outside the corpus root

validation.rationale: Current HEAD joined fixed output leaf names after parent validation and wrote them without final-component symlink protection. The metadata workflow reached its truncate before invoking the external reader.

verificationCommands: bunx vitest run test/corpus-provenance-index.test.ts --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 -t 'metadata census replaces a linked output leaf'
remediation.summary: Create and recheck the canonical output directory, bind each write to that directory descriptor, atomically replace complete output files, and append only through no-follow descriptors. A metadata symlink regression confirms the outside target remains unchanged.
